reviews.title: Best purifier
reviews.body: Best purifier till date, even Kent cannot match it. They also provide a tds meter, so you can check the tds anytime. Haven't faced any issue till now, will update the review if anything happens

reviews.title: Taste of water
reviews.body: Good but get m1 instead of this because if if set up the purifier on wall there is no option to connect extension pipe to the tap because of unusual shape of the tap and you will get m1 only 2.3k more than this and about the taste of water I had kent ro but because of service cost I bought this but the taste of water will not be same as kent ro because it's only ro not ro plus uv

reviews.author: Ravi Singh
reviews.title: Good Product at a reasonable price.
reviews.body: It’s a no-nonsense water purifier. You get RO + UV + a mineraliser, which is more than enough for most people. The installation was on time, and the technician was very good. If you’re looking for a fancy water purifier with all those gimmicky features, you might be disappointed with this one. But if you want a practical, reliable product, go for it.

reviews.title: I satisfied with this product
reviews.body: Buying to installation is very good experience. All parts is provided by company. No need to pay anything after purchasing.

reviews.author: حافظ خان (Hafiz Khan)
reviews.title: Hassle-free, sleek, and great-tasting water!
reviews.body: I am absolutely loving the Native M0! The biggest selling point is the 2-year zero-maintenance promise—no more annoying calls for filter changes or expensive AMC contracts every few months. The multi-stage purification makes the water taste crisp and clean, and the sleek design looks fantastic in my kitchen. Installation was quick and seamless. Highly recommend this to anyone looking for a reliable, "install-and-forget" purifier!
